claim.claim-text: 1. An α-galactosidase A protein having a mutation selected from the group consisting of: N53K, Q57R, S62delinsLA, M96V, R112L, D155E, N228D, Q330P, V339A, K391E and N408Y, wherein the protein is bound to migalastat.
2. The α-galactosidase A protein according to claim 1, wherein the mutation is selected from the group consisting of: D155E and N408Y.
3. The α-galactosidase A protein according to claim 1, wherein the mutation is selected from the group consisting of: N228D and N408Y.
4. The α-galactosidase A protein according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the mutation is N408Y.
5. The α-galactosidase A protein according to claim 1, wherein the mutation is S62delinsLA.

6. The α-galactosidase A protein according to any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the α-galactosidase A protein bound to migalastat is more stable than the same α-galactosidase A protein not bound to migalastat.

7. The α-galactosidase A protein according to any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the α-galactosidase A protein bound to migalastat has enhanced activity compared to the same α-galactosidase A protein not bound to migalastat.
